decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft default; departures close to afternoon may be considered when true afternoon options are limited or unattractive.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon departures for the return leg, considering departures close to afternoon when needed.
decisions.condition: When booking or comparing round-trip flights and selecting the return leg departure time.
decisions.default_action: Present return-flight options departing in the afternoon first and let the user choose among them.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not generalize this return-leg preference to outbound legs, and follow any explicit timing requirement for the current trip.
decisions.name: afternoon_return_departure_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer the return flight to depart in the afternoon.
decisions.rationale: Keep the calibrated representative as a distinct return-leg preference. Its leg-specific scope is not semantically interchangeable with the general afternoon-departure policy, and the evidence supports only a soft afternoon default with nearby times as a fallback.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply only as a general time-of-day preference without inferring a route, date, or leg-specific requirement.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer morning flight departures when no trip-specific timing constraint applies.
decisions.condition: When choosing a flight departure time and no trip-specific timing constraint overrides the preference.
decisions.exception_condition: Follow an explicitly stated timing requirement for the current trip; no reusable fallback is established when morning options are unavailable.
decisions.name: prefer_morning_flight_departures
decisions.rationale: Keep the calibrated representative as a reusable general preference. Morning and afternoon are contrasting alternatives rather than aliases, and current-trip timing requirements continue to override this soft default.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not apply the preference to a leg for which another time of day is explicitly requested.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer afternoon flight departures when workable options are available.
decisions.condition: When selecting a flight departure time and afternoon options are available.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize departure options in the afternoon.
decisions.exception_condition: Use another departure period when explicitly requested or when no workable afternoon option is available.
decisions.name: prefer_afternoon_flight_departures
decisions.rationale: Keep the calibrated representative as the general afternoon alternative. It must remain separate from the morning preference and from the return-leg-specific afternoon policy because those policies differ in value or scope.
